findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the containers holding clean utensils have an accumulation of food debris on the bottom. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of food debris. Ensure that the containers are cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed there was quat sanitizer spray bottles that were not labeled. The PIC labeled the bottles during the inspection. Ensure that containers for toxic materials removed from the bulk supplies are always labeled with the common name.
findings.citation_text: 7-102.11 Common Name. Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the unused cooler drawers under the grill have an accumulation of debris. The PIC was reminded that unused equipment must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Ensure that the drawers are cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed a consignment of single-used food containers in boxes stored on the floor in the hallway. Discuss with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that they will get them store properly. The consignment had just been delivered the day before and had to be temporarily stored at the observed location.  Ensure that single-used articles are stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash and other contaminants. Singles-used articles shall be stored at least 6” above the floor always.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: Inspector observed 3 boxes of food on the floor of the walk in cooler. Ensure that the food is stored off of the floor.

(A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Measuring spoons, cups, and other utensils are observed to be stored in a tub with soil and food crumbs in the bottom. Dump the tubs and clean on a regular basis to avoid this issue. 

4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The wall behind the 3 part sink is in disrepair.  Repair and seal the wall behind the 3 part sink. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
